preconditions: regional stratigraphic sequence is supplied separately
thickness observations are converted to true stratigraphic thickness where required
correlation lengths are normalized by an environment-relevant scale before cross-region comparison
logic: Generate transformed latent Gaussian thickness fields rather than independent contacts.
Represent absence/pinch-out with an explicit active mask or truncation process.
Couple layers with a symmetric positive-semidefinite cross-layer correlation matrix.
Stack non-negative thickness fields sequentially so adjacent units share exactly one contact.
uncertainty: Covariance form is universal machinery; coefficients and ranges remain environment/process conditioned.
exclusions: using one region's covariance as a global prior
pooling tectonic deformation with depositional thickness variation
forcing zero thickness through negative values
assuming stationary covariance across unconformities or facies-regime changes
validationMethod: leave-one-region-out on normalized thickness statistics and covariance summaries
reopenCondition: A multi-region normalized thickness corpus is assembled
